articles.title: The Best Kitchen Knife Sets Under $100
articles.description: Under a hundred dollars you can still get forged steel, full tang and a published contents list. Three that deliver, and the claims to ignore.

articles.title: Stamped vs Forged Kitchen Knives: Which Should You Buy?
articles.description: One is hammered from a bar of steel, the other cut from a sheet. The difference is in the hand, not in the edge — and the cheaper one is not worse.

articles.title: How Many Kitchen Knives Do You Actually Need?
articles.description: Three, and the third is arguable. What a 15-piece block really contains, and why the piece count is the worst way to compare two sets.

articles.title: The Best Japanese-Style Knife Sets
articles.description: A gyutou is ground near 15 degrees where a German knife sits around 20. That narrower edge bites more easily and forgives less. Three sets worth the attention.
